residual_risks: An unindexed full angular-spectrum theorem or a general facet-adjacency classification for stable-set polytopes could subsume the new result; negative retrieval does not prove uniqueness.

The graph edge-polytope 4-cycle adjacency substatement is previously established (Tran and Ziegler, as cited in arxiv:1801.06169), and stars are a previously covered specialization. Neither is being claimed as a new independent result.
The underlying metric is not invariant under arbitrary unimodular changes of polytope coordinates; the canonical coordinate realization is essential.
The original edge-polytope adjacency result is explicitly from 2013/2014, earlier than the chosen 2017 thematic lead source; it is supporting historical context, not a middle-cohort novelty claim.

value.rationale: Determines the full codimension-two Euclidean angle measure by count for every bipartite stable-set polytope in natural coordinates, including the previously uncounted leaf-sensitive coordinate–edge incidences. The complete histogram recovers three natural graph statistics, and the necessary-and-sufficient right-angle concentration law for all tree sequences contrasts with fixed obtuse mass in bicliques. The established edge-polytope subcount alone does not supply this classification.
